name: Florissant Fossil Beds National Monument
story: Florissant Fossil Beds National Monument is located in Colorado, USA. Established in 1969, the monument preserves a 34 million year old Eocene lake environment. It features an estimated 30 preserved redwood stumps that are among the largest petrified stumps in the world.
matters: The site matters because it protects paper shales holding exceptionally preserved insect and plant fossils, offering a detailed record of ancient geology and history.
